Dear Hiring Party,

I am writing to express my interest in hiring your Tindall Skylark for a commercial shoot. We would be picking it up on 6th July 2027 at 12:30 and returning it on July 8, 2027 at 12:30. I would kindly request that you bring it to the Saltmarsh Lighthouse Hotel where we will collect it afterwards. I have attached my driving licence as per your usual procedure.

Sincerely,
Zane Thistlewood
